question: How is the individual soul associated with the syllable ya to be visualized?
premises: The syllable ya is the reference point
An eightfold seed is associated with it
The soul is visualized as golden-radiant
inference: The soul linked to the eightfold seed of ya should be visualized as always golden-radiant
uncertainties: aṣṭasaṃbījaṃ is obscure and may refer to an eightfold seed configuration
plain_english: Visualize the individual soul as the eightfold seed of the syllable ya, always radiant like gold.
